title: GM LS V8 (Gen III/IV: 4.8/5.3/5.7/6.0/6.2) core specs
summary: LS head bolts are torque-to-yield: torque plus angle, and the bolts get replaced.

specs.name: Cylinder numbering
specs.value: Driver side 1-3-5-7, passenger side 2-4-6-8, front to rear

specs.name: Cylinder head bolts, M11 (torque-to-yield)
specs.value: 22 ft-lb, then 90 degrees, then 90 degrees (long) / 50 degrees (medium)
specs.note: In sequence. New bolts every time.

specs.name: Rocker arm bolts
specs.note: Non-adjustable; bring each cylinder to base circle first

specs.name: Harmonic balancer bolt (new bolt)
specs.note: Press the balancer on with an installer or the old bolt first

specs.name: Intake manifold bolts
specs.note: In sequence. Plastic manifold, don't over-torque.
